name: Wavelet-to-Gaussian Transition Bank
definition: An efficient procedure to construct Gaussian surrogates for wavelet kernels by fitting a single canonical Gaussian per subband and obtaining others via spatial translation, avoiding redundant fitting for every wavelet kernel.
summary: The Wavelet-to-Gaussian Transition Bank efficiently converts wavelet bases to Gaussian primitives for real-time rendering by using precomputed analytical mappings based on translation properties, avoiding redundant per-coefficient fitting.
